key_insight: QUFIG uses a circuit-DAG GNN to rank gate-fault pairs by vulnerability, enabling gate-level quantum fault injection analysis with precision.
engineering_relevance: It helps quantum engineers prioritize which gates to inspect and harden first under limited verification budgets in cloud quantum workflows.
method: Builds a circuit-DAG graph representation of the quantum circuit.
Uses a GNN backbone to predict vulnerability scores for each gate-fault pair.
Ranks pairs by predicted impact on circuit fidelity for inspection prioritization.
evidence_signal: On QASMbench and HamLib MaxCut, QUFIG finds high-impact vulnerable pairs with fewer inspections than random and depth-based heuristics, reducing gates needing inspection by 2.9–19.8%.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the circuit graph representation and the training/evaluation coverage of fault types, so generalization to unseen hardware or attack patterns may need validation.
paper_title: QUFIG: GNN-Based Prediction of Quantum Fault Injection Vulnerabilities with Gate-Level Precision
